newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour claims first scalp in cabinet.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour claims first scalp in cabinet.

text.p: Scottish Secretary Michael Forsyth lost his parliamentary seat to the Labour Party on Friday, becoming the first victim of Prime Minister John Major's cabinet in Britain's election.

Official results showed the Labour candidate Anne McGuire winning the Stirling seat in Scotland on a swing of 7.7 percent. Forsyth won it for the Conservatives by only 703 votes in the last election in 1992. Early results showed Labour heading for a landslide national victory after 18 years in opposition.
